summary.lv: ZABBIX SIA meklē vecāko infrastruktūras inženieri, kurš pārvaldīs serveru un mākoņu infrastruktūru (AWS/GCP/Azure), Ansible/Terraform automatizāciju un nodrošinās sistēmu stabilitāti.
summary.en: Zabbix seeks a Senior Infrastructure Engineer to manage core server and cloud infrastructure across AWS/GCP/Azure, automate with Ansible/Terraform, handle networking and backups, and ensure system reliability.
